sourceEvidence.measurementMethod: 1011×1348 原图逐区目视测绘；位置、面积与色彩预算为执行初值，不是源文件图层或像素分割结果
sourceEvidence.bboxConvention: [x0,y0,x1,y1]，单位为画布百分比；外接框可重叠，不可直接相加为可见面积

visualConclusion: 黑色舞台上，顶部六字逐字撕纸标题先给出强语义钩子；中部以城市地标、桥梁、地图和报纸建立时空档案；超大女性角色以左下到右上的失重姿态穿越其间；道路和底部撕裂报纸把悬浮叙事压回实体拼贴基座。
primaryMechanism: 以逐字撕纸大标题提供即时承诺，以超大对角动态主角制造情绪和停留，再用远中近三层城市档案、横向道路和纸张材质把抽象的穿越/迁移/探索变成可读叙事。

contentRoles.meaning: 唯一文字信息；逐字贴在独立撕边纸片上的单行主标题，是第一语义焦点
contentRoles.alignment: optical horizontal row with controlled overlap, micro rotation and vertical stagger

contentRoles.meaning: 标题后方横向报纸碎片，连接字体贴片与下部档案世界，不承载新文字
3–5 个建筑、设备、场景或证据剪纸形成的远景天际线，建立地点与时代语境
contentRoles.alignment: uneven horizontal skyline with central gaps and asymmetric heights

contentRoles.meaning: 桥梁、轨道、工作台或等价的大型横向结构，串联远景并托住主角
contentRoles.alignment: shallow diagonal inside a primarily horizontal band

contentRoles.meaning: 超大主角，以双腿伸向左侧、头和双臂伸向右上方的失重/跃迁动作穿过画面
contentRoles.alignment: dominant diagonal from lower-left to upper-right, approximately 20–28 degrees

contentRoles.meaning: 人物身份与情绪锚点；朝上或朝运动方向，保持五官完整
两臂形成向右上的二次方向线，强化被吸入、坠落或穿越的动作
contentRoles.alignment: parallel or slightly diverging from hero diagonal

contentRoles.meaning: 地图、票据、流程图或等价侧翼档案；补充语境并封住右边缘
自行车、交通工具、工作过程或其他小型叙事道具，提供尺度反差与故事细节
满宽横向道路/路径带，以车道线和斑马线提供稳定基线、现实尺度与运动方向
报纸、旧文档、地图或同类档案撕纸基座；上缘被道路压住，下缘保持明显手撕轮廓
contentRoles.alignment: full-width torn strip with uneven lower edge

contentRoles.meaning: 所有纸层之间露出的深色负空间与高对比舞台

firstFocus: 顶部逐字撕纸主标题；人物动作是同屏第一视觉动势，二者形成语义与情绪双钩子
secondaryFocus: 中部超大失重主角及右上脸部/双臂
tertiaryFocus: 城市档案天际线、横向道路和底部撕裂报纸

dominantAxis.primary: 从左下靴尖经躯干、脸部到右上手臂的 20°–28° 上升对角线
dominantAxis.secondary: 顶部标题、城市天际线、道路和底部档案组成的四条横向层带
dominantAxis.counterbalance: 左侧较重的双腿与建筑群，由右上脸部、双臂、钟楼和侧翼地图平衡

readingPath: 右上抬起的双手与脸部
沿躯干对角线回到左下双腿
回看地标、地图与小型交通道具

densityMap.top0To3Percent: 纯黑呼吸边，不放任何信息
densityMap.title4To23Percent: 高密度大字与独立纸片，但纸片之间仍露黑缝
densityMap.transition23To31Percent: 中低密度黑色天空与少量报纸碎片，分隔标题和场景
densityMap.narrative31To69Percent: 全画最高密度；建筑、桥梁、地图、人物和白边多层叠压
densityMap.road70To85Percent: 中密度横向稳定带；重复车道线和斑马线形成节奏
densityMap.archive85To99Percent: 高纹理、低信息的档案基座

protectedZones.rule: 只允许主标题、标题纸片及其少量背衬碎纸；人物、建筑和额外文案不得进入标题有效字面
人物五官、发际线和朝向必须完整可辨，不得被地图、建筑或道路遮挡
保留不规则黑色天空缝隙，不能用贴纸或说明文字填满
道路连续满宽；主角可跨越，但新增物件不得破坏主要车道线和斑马线识别

layerOrder: rear newspaper scraps and paper shadows
far archive skyline and torn horizon backing
midground bridge or equivalent structural connector
full-width road band above the archive base
hero subject with inner ink contour and thick warm-white cut-paper halo
individual torn title tiles and printed glyphs

subjectTreatment.heroStyle: watercolour-and-ink editorial illustration or materially equivalent analogue cutout

colorRoles.measurementStatus: 目测互斥面积预算，待复刻成图校准
colorRoles.contrastLogic: 极深舞台与暖白纸层形成最高一级明度反差；黑字和暖色强调字均印在浅纸上；城市与道路保持中灰，主角皮肤/强调色与少量冷色从灰阶档案中跳出。
requiredRelations: title remains readable in grayscale even when one semantic segment uses an accent colour
paper is lighter than architecture and road but warmer than pure digital white
accent colour occupies a minority area and groups meaning instead of scattering evenly
hero face and hands remain warmer or more chromatic than the archive background
specific colour values are reselected for each topic

required: full-bleed near-black stage
one torn paper tile per title glyph
coarse screenprint or letterpress fill inside glyphs
irregular fibrous torn edges and small paper shadows
warm-white cut-paper halo around hero and major evidence cutouts
analogue watercolour-and-ink hero rendering
grayscale archive skyline with selective warm roofs or details
full-width road with repeated lane markings and one zebra-crossing rhythm
bottom torn newspaper or document strip
visible but controlled paper/newsprint grain
forbidden: clean vector poster with no physical paper depth
uniform tile shapes or identical rotations
photoreal subject pasted over cartoon scenery
random sticker wall with no foreground-middle-background order
global sepia filter that muddies the title
heavy outer glow, neon, bevel, glossy 3d or long digital shadow
uniform noise over the black negative space

locked: single-line top title built from one irregular torn tile per glyph
one contiguous 1–2 glyph accent segment against a dark-ink majority
archive skyline and structural connector across the middle
one oversized hero in a lower-left to upper-right suspended-motion diagonal
thick light cut-paper halo around hero and evidence cutouts
one full-width road/path band and one bottom torn archive strip
title → skyline → hero diagonal → road → archive reading path
analogue paper, newsprint and print texture with real layer shadows
adaptive: title wording within the fixed single-line length contract
hero identity, clothing, expression and industry-specific motion while preserving the diagonal suspended pose
3–5 skyline/evidence cutouts and one small journey/process prop
newspaper, map, ticket, manual, drawing or document content that genuinely supports the topic
specific colour values while preserving role, lightness, temperature and area hierarchy
optional: one partially cropped side archive fragment
two to four restrained ink spatters attached to title paper or archive scraps
one small transport/process prop under or behind the hero
a semantic equivalent of a road only if it remains a physical full-width path with repeated directional markings
forbidden: adding subtitle, brand bar, CTA or body copy
turning the layout into a regular scrapbook grid
shrinking the hero to a corner sticker
removing the road or bottom archive base without a separately tested variant
using generic AI people or unrelated landmark cutouts
locking the reference red, blue or paper hue as universal colours
ordinary bold type, hard-fold-heiti or a clean rectangle silently replacing the registered title dependency
marking the template approved or active before tests and user acceptance

transformationGrammar.when: 已有身份清楚、四肢完整且方向合适的动态人物/动物素材
transformationGrammar.action: 保留身份和动作锚点，抠图后转成水彩墨线或等价模拟印刷插画，并增加暖白剪纸边、短纸影和受控裂纹
transformationGrammar.reason: 统一主角与档案拼贴材质，同时保持事实和身份

transformationGrammar.when: 主角素材只有站姿、证件照或动作方向相反
transformationGrammar.action: 优先补拍；否则受身份约束重建为左下到右上的悬浮/跃迁姿态，并逐项审核脸、手、腿、鞋和服装连续性
transformationGrammar.reason: 对角失重动作是模板身份，不可用平移或旋转站姿伪造

transformationGrammar.when: 场景证据来自照片且色彩/光线互不一致
transformationGrammar.action: 分别抠图、简化为灰阶或低饱和档案层，统一纸边、颗粒、光向、尺度和前后景，再构成不等高天际线
transformationGrammar.reason: 把多源素材组织成同一物理拼贴世界

transformationGrammar.action: 把道路映射为真实可穿行的行业路径，如生产线、时间轴平台、工作台或书页通道；保留满宽横带、重复方向标记与底部档案基座
transformationGrammar.reason: 迁移语义而不丢失横向稳定结构

transformationGrammar.when: 标题不足 5 字、超过 7 字或需要副标题
transformationGrammar.action: 先改写到 5–7 个中文等效字并保持单行；仍不成立则换模板
transformationGrammar.reason: 不扩张标题区、不缩成失读小字、不新增第二行

strong: 迁移、成长、冒险和人生转场
可由多个地点/阶段/证据串成故事的教程或知识主题
具备动态主角与档案素材的品牌叙事
conditional: 宠物、产品、读书、AI 或专家内容，前提是能自然提供动态主角、3–5 个证据场景和路径隐喻
商业主题，前提是手工档案感符合品牌而且不依赖精确产品摄影
reject: 高端极简、奢侈品静物和必须干净展示产品细节的内容
严肃风险告知、医疗法律结论和需要大量正文的信息
多人群像、清单型信息图、单一产品白底电商图
只有静态证件照且不允许动作重建的内容

failureModes: 标题变成一整块海报底或普通粗黑字，逐字贴片身份消失
纸片随机旋转过度、字距断裂或标题超过一行，缩略图无法连续阅读
主角只是站姿素材旋转后悬浮，四肢受力、头发和服装重力不成立
建筑、地图、道路和报纸彼此无主题关系，沦为随机复古素材堆砌
主角过小或被档案层吞没，失去对角动作焦点
全画统一泛黄、颗粒过重或裂纹覆盖五官，画面脏而不旧
道路、桥梁和底部报纸压成同一平面，没有前中后景
白边忽粗忽细、数字投影过长或图层交叠没有接触阴影，像廉价贴纸
配色把红黑蓝锁死，无法适配新主题
新增副标题、Logo、CTA 或标签填满黑色呼吸缝

required: 3:4 full-bleed black stage preserved
main title is verbatim, single-line and one tile per glyph
title remains readable at 360px
hero identity and all limbs are coherent
hero diagonal, skyline, road and archive base are all recognisable
3–5 evidence cutouts are semantically related
foreground-middle-background masking and contact shadows are credible
paper, ink and newsprint textures are local and controlled
colour roles adapt without locking exact values
no unregistered font fallback, subtitle, CTA or active status
